document.disclaimer: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE - NOT A CERTIFIED BATTERY PASSPORT. This document is generated by a university research project (CellSense). It is not issued under, and makes no claim of compliance with, Regulation (EU) 2023/1542. The numbers are model estimates with the stated uncertainty and limits; they are not measurements and must not be used for safety-critical, commercial or legal decisions without an independent measured capacity test.

state_of_health.interval_note: interval calibrated on known sources; its coverage is NOT reliable for this battery
state_of_health.definition: discharge capacity relative to the battery's first cycles, in percent

expected_remaining_life.reason: its nearest-source score (nll_min = 240.1) is at or above the flag threshold (-5.5); nearest known source: snl
expected_remaining_life.rule: RUL is shown only when the nearest known source is NASA or MIT and the battery is not flagged

trust_status.status: Unfamiliar battery - treat predictions with caution
trust_status.not_detected_note: About 1 in 5 unfamiliar batteries are not detected; check against a measured capacity when possible.
